newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - VAISALA 4-MONTH PROFIT SEEN UP.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - VAISALA 4-MONTH PROFIT SEEN UP.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts
covering Finnish equities showed a 36 million markka median
forecast for Finnish meteorological equipment maker Vaisala Oy's
January-April profit before extraordinary items and tax.
Profit before extras, tax
(FIM million)
Median 36
Mean 36.1
Lowest 31
Highest 39
(Profit forecasts by seven analysts).
Vaisala's results are due on June 9 around 1700/1400 GMT.
In January-April 1996, Vaisala posted a profit of 29.3
million markka.
In February, Vaisala said its sales in 1997 would go on
growing and profitability would remain good.
The median of five analysts' forecasts for Vaisala's
full-year 1997 profit before extras and tax was 133 million
markka (mean 136 million) in a 129-144 million markka range.
In 1996, Vaisala's profit was 112 million markka.
Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, Aktia Bank,
Aros Securities, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities,
Merita Securities and Postipankki.
